subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

 'A+ B' means 'A is the sister of B'

 'A – B' means 'A is the brother of B'

 'A × B' means 'A is the wife of B'

 'A ÷ B' means 'A is the father of B'

 Based on the above, how is M related to Q if 'M × N ÷ O – P + Q'?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

Given: M × N ÷ O – P + Q

M × N → M is the wife of N.

N ÷ O → N is the father of O.

O – P → O is the brother of P.

P + Q → P is the sister of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1279c5e410ecc8f7fa49774be702c0ac31eb25ef2cb08faab9561ee78697517a.png] 

Here, M is Q's mother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
